entries.title: Loop Hero

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the complete game in a native release with PC capture/settings flexibility. Switch, Xbox, and mobile versions are documented access routes, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Loop Hero on Steam, Epic Games Store, or GOG for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with capture/settings flexibility.
